findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_contact_requests, prepurchase_brief · Private data: file_complaint, complaint_bureau, claim_github, talk_to_representative, request_contact, list_contact_requests, respond_contact_request, give_feedback · Public sink: file_complaint, register_agent, request_contact, submit_rating, prepurchase_brief.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_contact_requests, prepurchase_brief · Private data: file_complaint, complaint_bureau, claim_github, talk_to_representative, request_contact, list_contact_requests, respond_contact_request, give_feedback · Public sink: file_complaint, register_agent, request_contact, submit_rating, prepurchase_brief

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "register_agent" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
